[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Another German translation for Stardew Valley Expanded, initially created using LLM/GPT (for reasonings, check out the last section [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21920]here[/url]). 
Feel free to contribute at [url=https://github.com/tienducle/Stardew-Valley-Expanded-DE-Translation]https://github.com/tienducle/Stardew-Valley-Expanded-DE-Translation[/url]

[size=4][b]Install - [/b][b]Manually[/b][/size]
[size=2]From the zip file, extract the following folders into your Stardew Valley Mods folder:[/size]
[code]﻿﻿Stardew Valley
└── Mods
    ├── Stardew Valley Expanded
    │   └── [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded
optional:
    ├── Grandpa's Farm
    │   └── [CP] Grandpa's Farm
    └── Immersive Farm 2 Remastered
        └── [CP] Immersive Farm 2 Remastered
[/code]
The Stardew Valley Expanded - German Translation folder just contains a manifest file, so that you get notified by SMAPI when a new version of the main translation is available.

[size=4]﻿[b]Install - Using Installer[/b][/size]
[size=2]The installer can be found under optional files.
When running the installer, you just need to provide the path to your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
This is just purely for convenience and does the same steps as above.
Note: The installer [b]does not automatically[/b] determine your Mods folder. The default value is
"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods"[/size]

[b][size=4]Release Notes[/size][/b]
See [url=https://github.com/tienducle/Stardew-Valley-Expanded-DE-Translation/releases]https://github.com/tienducle/Stardew-Valley-Expanded-DE-Translation/releases[/url]
